name: Cryptography
description: Skills related to applied cryptography, cryptographic protocol analysis, and cryptographic system assessment. Covers both theoretical understanding and practical evaluation of cryptographic implementations. Distinct from HWSEC-CRYPTO which focuses on hardware-level cryptographic implementation assessment.

categories.name: Symmetric Cryptography
categories.description: Assessment of symmetric cryptographic algorithms and modes. Covers block ciphers, stream ciphers, modes of operation, key derivation, and authenticated encryption.

categories.name: Asymmetric Cryptography
categories.description: Assessment of asymmetric/public-key cryptographic algorithms. Covers RSA, elliptic curve cryptography, Diffie-Hellman, digital signatures, and key exchange protocols.

categories.name: Hash Functions
categories.description: Assessment of cryptographic hash functions and their applications. Covers collision resistance, preimage resistance, HMAC, password hashing, and Merkle tree constructions.

categories.name: PKI & Infrastructure
categories.description: Public key infrastructure assessment. Covers certificate management, CA security, certificate validation, TLS/SSL assessment, and PKI architecture review.

categories.name: Post-Quantum Cryptography
categories.description: Assessment of post-quantum cryptographic algorithms and migration readiness. Covers lattice-based, hash-based, and code-based schemes, quantum threat assessment, and crypto-agility evaluation.

categories.name: Implementation & Validation
categories.description: Validation and review of cryptographic implementations. Covers algorithm validation testing (CAVP/ACVP), entropy source and DRBG assessment, and constant-time and software side-channel review.

categories.name: Cryptographic Protocols
categories.description: Analysis of cryptographic protocol designs for their security properties. Covers established and custom protocols, formal protocol verification and end-to-end encrypted secure messaging. TLS assessment is covered under PKI & Infrastructure.
